constraints.name: account_documents_owner_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: registered_devices_owner_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_documents_pkey ON public.account_documents USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_documents_owner_document_key_key ON public.account_documents USING btree (owner, document_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX registered_devices_pkey ON public.registered_devices USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX registered_devices_owner_device_id_key ON public.registered_devices USING btree (owner, device_id)

triggers.name: touch_account_documents_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER touch_account_documents_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.account_documents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()

triggers.name: touch_registered_devices_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER touch_registered_devices_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.registered_devices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()
